Side B, track 5 · Oct 30, 2026 · 33 min

Is Riot Music Back? K/DA, Heartsteel & Worlds Anthems

Spotify Apple Podcasts
B5

Show notes

Is Riot Games still the king of video game music? We break down League of Legends’ Worlds anthems over the years and Riot’s virtual bands, from K/DA and True Damage to Heartsteel. Which projects hit, which ones missed, and is a K/DA comeback exactly what Riot needs?
